blocks.text: Except in compliance with an order of a court of competent jurisdiction, or upon an applicant's written request, AMEs will not divulge or release copies of any reports prepared in connection with the examination to anyone other than the applicant or the FAA. A copy of the examination may be released to the applicant upon request. (See: Request for Airman Medical Records Form 8065-2 ).
